userDirection: User explicitly requested multiple views of Ta Prohm. Keep detailed natural watercolor and actual photographed ruined condition.

Preserve actual relative scale, overlaps, carved erosion, missing blocks, irregular roof outlines, broken openings and all tree-root paths. Do not reconstruct or straighten anything. No new temples, no intact invented roofs, no symmetric idealized facade. Landscape 16:9, fit by modest near foreground only, do not invent structures beyond photo. Match this project's approved fine watercolor travel series: crisp readable masonry volumes with fine brush detail, translucent warm-grey and ochre washes, natural nuanced forest greens, subtle paper grain, soft dappled daylight, rich spatial depth. Not blurry loose watercolor, harsh black outline or a photographic filter. Keep photographed tree trunk and canopy; no bright fantasy sky. No people, UI, black margins, text, signage, logo, watermark or border. Keep the historic ruins in the exact condition shown by the photograph.

No hard black ink, no photographic filter or blur. No humans, text, signage, logo, UI, watermark or border.

Preserve the huge near foreground tree trunk at left that occludes the gallery, slim tall tree at right behind the gate, dense varied forest canopy behind, sandy courtyard with sparse grass across foreground and existing discreet visitor rope barrier at far right. Broad 16:9 landscape with readable architectural depth, maintaining exactly this oblique perspective, modest expansion only of foreground earth. Match previous generated fine watercolor: precise architectural masses, intricate delicate brush detail, translucent grey/ochre/olive washes, natural greens, subtle cotton paper texture, soft forest daylight with light sun flecks.
